title: Design System: Tunas Muda Biodiversity — The Bound Field Notebook

display.purpose: Hero headline only; Instrument Serif italic is a voice for emphasis and binomials, never bold.

headline.purpose: Section headings in the display serif.

body.purpose: All sentence-case reading copy; prose capped at 68ch via .prose-journal.

label.purpose: Museum-stamp register: stamps, plate numbers, badges, table keys, section eyebrows, breadcrumbs. Uppercase with 0.14em tracking, tabular figures.

shadows.name: print-lift
shadows.purpose: Photographs taped into the notebook (field-guide prints).

shadows.name: hero-print-lift
shadows.purpose: The annotated hero photograph, slightly stronger.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The proposal letter sheet floating on the paper-deep desk.

shadows.name: header-lift
shadows.purpose: Applied only while scrolled — state indication, not decoration.

shadows.name: stamp-inset
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 3.5px var(--color-paper), inset 0 0 0 4.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brass) 55%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Double-ring specimen stamp, inside a 1.5px solid brass border.

motion.name: ease-journal
motion.purpose: The one curve; every animation and transition uses it. Extended, never forked.

motion.name: dur-reveal
motion.purpose: Content entrances (journal-in; field-guide image hover scale 1.035).

motion.name: keyframe-print-lay
motion.purpose: The hero photograph being laid into the book (.hero-print, 720ms @ 260ms delay).

motion.name: keyframe-rule-draw
motion.purpose: Roadmap rail segments drawing in sequence (.rail-seg, 560ms, 100–450ms delays). A sequence, never a progress bar.

motion.name: keyframe-anchor-flash
motion.purpose: One-shot emphasis after a research ToC jump (.anchor-flash, 900ms; removed on animationend).

motion.name: keyframe-menu-in
motion.purpose: Mobile menu disclosure (.menu-in, dur-ui). Never scales or bounces.

motion.name: reveal-contract
motion.value: Reveal.tsx: server HTML visible; [data-motion-pending] hides after JS mount; [data-revealed] plays once (IO rootMargin 0 0 -12% 0, threshold 0.05, disconnects). Skips in-viewport-at-mount and prefers-reduced-motion. Children stagger 60–360ms via :nth-child(1..6). No-JS-safe: content never hidden.

motion.name: motion-hover-variant
motion.purpose: Custom Tailwind variant gating all hover-driven movement; touch devices get none.

motion.name: reduced-motion-backstop
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → smooth scroll off, all durations 0.001s !important, [data-motion-pending] .reveal-child forced visible
motion.purpose: globals.css backstop; Reveal also re-checks in JS.

motion.name: print-backstop
motion.value: @media print → all reveal/hero/rail animations none !important, opacity 1, transform none
motion.purpose: Nothing stays hidden for a reader who prints or saves to PDF.

motion.name: refused-patterns
motion.value: pointer parallax, floating leaves/particles/cursor trails, per-word animation, scroll-jacking, arbitrary parallax, bounce/scale entrances, scroll-triggered re-animation

materials.name: dot-grid
materials.purpose: Research notebook graph-paper ruling. Deliberate, not a detector defect.

materials.name: paper-grain
materials.value: SVG fractalNoise data-URI overlay, opacity 0.5 (0.3 on footer)
materials.purpose: Fine paper texture over hero and forest footer.

materials.name: taped
materials.value: 96×26px moss/68% strips, dashed botanical/35% side borders, rotated -4deg/-3deg, overhanging corners ±22px/±11px
materials.purpose: Tape holding photographs into the notebook; overhang clipped at main via overflow-x-clip, never hidden.

materials.name: line-unrecorded
materials.purpose: Confidence: not recorded. Also marks honesty/limitation blocks.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest fill; the main call to action (Explore Our Research, Read the Research).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--color-forest); color: var(--color-paper); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-forest-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass-ink); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined companion (Discover the Plants); hover washes moss.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-forest); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-forest) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-forest); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-moss) 60%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Truthful status chips; the vocabulary is closed to three values. In progress belongs to the website itself.
components.html: In progress Requires approval Proposed
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid; } .ds-status--progress { background: var(--color-botanical); color: var(--color-paper); border-color: var(--color-botanical); } .ds-status--approval { background: rgba(177,139,93,0.15); color: var(--color-brass-ink); border-color: rgba(138,106,62,0.7); } .ds-status--proposed { background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink-soft); border-color: var(--color-sage); }

components.name: Specimen Stamp
components.description: The archival label of the notebook world: brass double-ring frame around tracked small caps.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-brass-ink); background: rgba(246,244,237,0.6); padding: 7px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-brass); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3.5px var(--color-paper), inset 0 0 0 4.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brass) 55%, transparent); }

components.name: Taped Print
components.description: Signature: a photograph taped into the notebook with plate-number caption. Tape overhangs the corners; src=null renders the Evidence Gap instead.
components.css: .ds-print-taped { position: relative; } .ds-print-taped::before, .ds-print-taped::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 96px; height: 26px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-moss) 68%, transparent); border-left: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-botanical) 35%, transparent); border-right: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-botanical) 35%, transparent); z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; } .ds-print-taped::before { top: -11px; left: -22px; transform: rotate(-4deg); } .ds-print-taped::after { bottom: -11px; right: -22px; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-print-photo { aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--color-sage), var(--color-moss)); border: 1px solid var(--color-stone); box-shadow: 0 22px 44px -30px rgba(32,40,34,0.55); } .ds-print-caption { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(168,184,160,0.5); } .ds-print-plate { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-brass-ink); margin-top: 3px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-print-text { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Evidence Gap
components.description: Signature honesty component: the designed placeholder where a photograph is missing. Never substitute an image.
components.html:
Evidence gap

This photograph is listed in the report as primary evidence, but the file was not available when the site was built. The record stays open until it is found.
components.css: .ds-gap { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3/4; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 32px; text-align: center; background: var(--color-paper-deep); border: 1px dashed var(--color-sage); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, var(--color-stone) 0 1px, transparent 1px 14px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 7px, var(--color-stone) 7px 8px, transparent 8px 14px); } .ds-gap-label { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-brass-ink); } .ds-gap-copy { max-width: 34ch; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Confidence Mark
components.description: Evidence state as line treatment: solid=observed, dashed=preliminary, dotted=not recorded. Always shown with the legend.
components.html: Observed directly Preliminary — genus level Not recorded
components.css: .ds-conf { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-conf-line { display: block; width: 40px; } .ds-conf-line--observed { border-top: 2px solid var(--color-botanical); } .ds-conf-line--preliminary { border-top: 2px dashed var(--color-brass); } .ds-conf-line--unrecorded { border-top: 2px dotted var(--color-sage); } .ds-conf-label { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Primary Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation with a botanical underline indicator that scales in from the left on the active route.
components.html: ResearchEcosystemProposal
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-soft); text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 3px; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--color-forest); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 12px -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--color-botanical); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link--active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-cta { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-forest); text-decoration: none; padding: 7px 14px; margin-left: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-forest) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--color-forest); color: var(--color-paper); }

narrative.overview: This is a school campus's overlooked vegetation given the care of a real research archive. The page object is a bound field notebook lying open: warm dot-grid paper ground, photographs taped in with overhanging tape strips, specimen stamps pressed in brass, and dense specimen data set in tracked small caps. The natural-history-museum register — plate numbers, leader-line annotations, archival captions — supplies the precision; the notebook supplies the warmth. It explicitly refuses the sustainability landing page and every predictable eco-branding move. The system's second idea is that evidence state is a visual material: solid line means observed, dashed means preliminary, dotted means unrecorded — the same three treatments mark list bullets, section borders, confidence marks, and the missing photograph, which becomes a designed woven gap rather than a substitute image. Motion extends the same temperament: one easing curve, one duration scale, reveals that play once and never fight the reader.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with 26px dot-grid ruling and fine SVG paper grain
Photographs as physical objects: taped prints with overhanging tape, deep soft shadows, plate numbers
Evidence state as line treatment: solid = observed, dashed = preliminary, dotted = unrecorded
Brass reserved for stamps, plate numbers, and specimen labels — the only accent
Instrument Serif display (with italic as a voice) over Geist grotesque small caps
Near-square geometry (2–3px), hairline borders, tonal depth instead of card shadows
Motion: one curve (--ease-journal), four durations, one-shot reveals, pointer-gated hovers

rules.name: The Line-State Rule
rules.body: Evidence state is carried by line treatment, not by color alone: 2px solid botanical = observed directly, 2px dashed brass = preliminary, 2px dotted sage = not recorded. Every confidence display ships with the standing legend. Never introduce a fourth treatment or reassign these three.

rules.name: The Brass-Rarity Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only as thin frames, small caps text, or 15%-opacity tints — stamps, plate numbers, section labels, focus rings. It never becomes a large fill or a button background; its rarity is what makes it read as pressed metal on paper.

rules.name: The Forest-as-Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Dark forest sections are events, used to close a narrative (home closing spread, footer) — never alternating card backgrounds. On forest, body copy uses moss/sage tints and headings use paper.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Anything a museum would stamp or index — stamps, plate numbers, badges, table keys, breadcrumbs, and dense section headings set in the specimen register — is Geist label style (11px/600/0.14em uppercase, tabular). Everything a human reads in sentences is sentence case. Scientific binomials and pull-quote emphasis use the serif italic — never bold the display face. Record headers ARE the label; the build's occasional brass label-line above a display heading is a carried defect, not a pattern to repeat.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Long-form prose never exceeds ~68ch (.prose-journal p); supporting copy blocks cap at 46–64ch. Headlines use text-wrap: balance and explicit max-w-[Nch] to control line count.

rules.name: The Physical-Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow means an object resting on the page — a photograph, a sheet of paper, a header that has changed state. Ordinary containers, list items, and links are flat. If a new element isn't pretending to be a physical thing, it gets a hairline border and a tonal step, not a shadow.

dos: Do carry evidence state with the three line treatments (solid/dashed/dotted) and always pair confidence marks with the standing legend.
Do ship MissingEvidence whenever a photograph is absent — dashed frame, weave, plain-language copy — and keep the record open around it.
Do keep the closed status vocabulary (Proposed / Requires approval / In progress); "In progress" means the website, and nothing may imply Ms. Gia has approved anything.
Do gate hover-driven movement behind motion-hover and time every transition on the shared curve and duration scale.
Do use Reveal one-shot for major lists and ledgers; keep report prose and the letter body static.
Do clip tape overhang with overflow-x-clip on main (never hidden), and keep the print backstops working when adding any animated element.
Do build ledgers from gap-px over stone and separate bands with hairline borders and tonal steps.
Do set labels, stamps, and specimen data in tracked uppercase small caps with tabular figures, and cap prose at ~68ch.
donts: Don't invent species, counts, wildlife, measurements, approvals, outcomes, or photographs. Observed, preliminary, interpretive, and unknown must stay distinguishable; limitations stay visible.
Don't substitute any image, illustration, or stock photo for the missing Observation 4 photograph — the evidence gap is the honest answer.
Don't treat site dates as build dates: "27 October 2026" is the report's own content truth.
Don't add parallax, particles, floating leaves, cursor trails, per-word animation, scroll-jacking, or re-firing scroll animations.
Don't turn the roadmap rail into a progress bar or color it by completion; it is neutral sequence, and the badges carry status.
Don't let brass become a fill, add neon greens or gradients, or reach for stock sustainability-template layouts, pill shapes, or generic card grids.
Don't add a fourth confidence treatment, a new status value, or a second easing curve or duration outside the recorded scale.

Don't add a small-caps label line directly above a display heading (a kicker/eyebrow). The heading carries its own weight; use the label style for the heading itself or for genuine specimen data, not for a redundant line above it.
